description: Raw observation time-series for a SPECIFIC x402 endpoint: listing/delisting/relisting events, advertised price changes, payTo changes, and probe results over the requested window (1-90 days). Each probe carries 'ts', 'ok', 'latencyMs', 'amount' plus its outcome 'status' (success, dns_error, timeout, http_error, ...), 'httpStatus', an 'error' detail and an 'excluded' flag; excluded probes carry no endpoint signal (rate limits, unresolved URL templates, resolver outages on our side) and never count as downtime. A 'probeSummary' aggregates the window: counts by status, longest failure streak, per-day failure breakdown. Per-probe 'latencyMs' is measured from a single EU vantage point and includes network distance to the endpoint. Pay-per-call over x402; auto-pays if a wallet is configured, otherwise returns the price quote.
name: x402_endpoint_history
title: x402 endpoint observation history (paid)
